name: Cape Town
tagline: Stunning Natural Beauty, World-Class Wine, and Remarkable Affordability
description: Cape Town is consistently ranked among the most beautiful cities in the world, and for FIRE retirees the value proposition is extraordinary. Table Mountain, pristine beaches, a thriving food and wine scene, and modern infrastructure come at a fraction of Western prices. The rand's weakness against the dollar means your portfolio stretches remarkably far. English is widely spoken, healthcare quality is high at private facilities, and the Mediterranean climate delivers mild winters and warm, dry summers. Load-shedding (rolling blackouts) remains an occasional nuisance but is increasingly managed with solar and battery solutions.

quickFacts.visa: 90-day visa-free stay for US citizens; retirement visa available
quickFacts.safetyRating: Moderate – exercise caution, avoid certain areas at night
quickFacts.climate: Mediterranean with warm dry summers and mild wet winters

housing.description: Modest but safe apartment in Observatory, Woodstock, or the city-bowl fringe, on the MyCiTi line

dining.description: Mostly home cooking with cheap local café lunches

healthcare.description: Basic local medical aid (Discovery Core/entry hospital plan) for a 45–55 early retiree

transportation.description: MyCiTi bus plus minibus taxis and occasional Uber; no car

entertainment.description: Free hikes and beaches, occasional cinema, a basic gym

1M.lifestyle: A modest but safe apartment in Observatory, Woodstock, or the city-bowl fringe, right on the MyCiTi line and walking distance from markets. Days lean on Cape Town's free assets — Table Mountain trails, the Sea Point promenade, and public beaches — with cheap café lunches and mostly home cooking. Transport is the MyCiTi bus, minibus taxis, and the occasional Uber; no car. Cover is a bare Discovery Core/entry hospital plan, so a chronic condition would strain this budget, and load-shedding is managed the low-tech way. Frugal and careful, but genuinely pleasant.

housing.description: Decent central apartment in Sea Point or Green Point, walkable to the promenade

dining.description: Out several times a week, mid-range and casual

transportation.description: Daily Uber/Bolt plus occasional car hire; still no owned car

entertainment.description: Gym, cinema, wine bars, live events

2M.lifestyle: A decent central apartment in Sea Point or Green Point puts the Atlantic promenade, cafés, and gyms on the doorstep, with daily Uber/Bolt and the occasional car hire covering the rest — still no owned car. Eating out several nights a week is unremarkable, mixing mid-range and casual spots. Comprehensive local medical aid (Discovery Saver/Priority) removes the hospital-plan anxiety of the Lean tier. Discretionary spending on gym, cinema, wine bars, and live events is easy but not lavish.

housing.description: Good apartment in Sea Point, Gardens, or the Camps Bay fringe; newer, secure building

dining.description: Frequent quality dining across Cape Town's strong restaurant scene

healthcare.description: Strong private cover (Discovery Classic Comprehensive, R7,528)

transportation.description: A modest owned car or unlimited ride-hail

entertainment.description: Frequent activities plus winelands weekends and short domestic trips

3M.lifestyle: A newer, secure apartment in Sea Point, Gardens, or the Camps Bay fringe, with mountain or sea glimpses. Dining out across Cape Town's strong restaurant scene becomes a default rather than an event, and weekends mean the winelands, Hermanus, or a Garden Route drive in a modest owned car (or unlimited ride-hail). Full Discovery Classic Comprehensive cover puts private specialists and top hospitals fully in play. A small inverter/UPS handles load-shedding without drama, and fast fibre covers the rest.

housing.description: Luxury apartment in Clifton, Bantry Bay, or Camps Bay with sea views

dining.description: Near-daily dining including Cape Town's fine-dining tier

healthcare.description: Top-tier local medical aid (Discovery Executive) plus gap cover

transportation.description: A nicer owned car with fuel, insurance, and secure parking

entertainment.description: Clubs, events, wine estates, frequent domestic travel

luxuryExtras.description: Personal trainer, spa, wine club, memberships, travel

5M.lifestyle: Atlantic-Seaboard luxury — a luxury apartment in Clifton, Bantry Bay, or Camps Bay with the ocean as the view and the restaurant strip a short drive away. A part-time housekeeper comes two or three days a week, dining out is near-nightly including the fine-dining tier, and top-tier Discovery Executive cover plus gap cover and a nicer car remove every friction. Full inverter/solar backup makes load-shedding a non-event. Wine estates, spa days, and frequent domestic travel round it out.

transportation.description: Luxury car ownership with fuel, insurance, parking (driver under domesticHelp)

entertainment.description: Private events, frequent first-class travel, memberships

domesticHelp.description: Full-time housekeeper/cook plus a part-time driver

luxuryExtras.description: Concierge, charters/heli days, high-end shopping, art, first-class travel top-up

10M.lifestyle: A superb Clifton or Camps Bay apartment with sea views, kept by a full-time housekeeper/cook with a part-time driver. Dining is near-daily at world-class restaurants with fine wine, and international concierge cover will fly you out if needed. A luxury owned car, full solar and backup, and a discretionary budget for charters, high-end shopping, art, and first-class travel put almost nothing out of reach. This is the Atlantic Seaboard done exceptionally well — a prime sea-facing address, staff on hand, and the winelands and coast at the weekend.
